name: Waterside Adventure Playground
description: An adventure playground and youth project at 50 Dame Street, by the Regent's Canal. Run by Awesome Adventure Play for children aged 6 and over who live or go to school in Islington (register with them first). Term time: Tuesday to Friday 3:30pm to 6:30pm; Saturday Family Play for all ages with a parent or carer, 11:30am to 4:30pm.
